server_url.title: Server Address
server_url.description: The address you open your server at, for example http://192.168.1.20:4533 or https://music.example.com.

transcode_format.title: Format When the Server Converts
transcode_format.description: What the server converts to when a file is above the streaming quality you chose in Jellyfesh or in a format Jellyfesh cannot play. Converted downloads use Opus when this is Opus, otherwise MP3.
